conclusion: The tested protein-conditioned interaction mechanisms are closed as NOT ESTIMABLE / negative on this corpus and protocol. This is a bounded answer: it does not prove that protein-conditioned local interaction is biologically impossible, and it does not extend to other datasets, other representations, or untested equivalence classes.
future_positive_would_require: a corpus in which a complete core/context-matched transformation recurs across many protein components, or
a governed MSA/coevolution snapshot (currently absent) plus a new preregistered stage, or

a preregistered looser-but-principled transformation equivalence class with its own cancellation analysis; such a result alone could only be an identification screen, not the objective's strict positive gate.
question: With protein sequence-derived features and ligand 2D features only, can a model learn a protein-conditioned local interaction signal that transfers to unseen protein components and aligns with affinity-difference / SAR ordering?
scope: governed BindingDB-Ki double-cold v1, same-panel Ki supervision, single-cut core-inclusive MMP transformations, physical split view; meta_test sealed and never evaluated.
summary: Stage S: whole-molecule pair global FiLM field failed controls (correct +0.0065 vs ligand-only; shuffled protein reproduced gain; large misaligned protein shift).
Stage P: centered objective made protein response reproducible but truth-unaligned (+0.022 alignment).

Stage T: core-blind MMP key + pooled protein discriminator rejected; forensic correction showed 40.4% of training D rows had disjoint cores, so its exact-cancellation claim and global closure were withdrawn.
Stage U: core-inclusive key frozen; U0 admission failed on degree concentration (one target/component 29.63% of primary observations).

Stage V: V0 degree-concentration fail; V0b primary repeated-key internal surface 32 rows/4 components (<100 evaluability floor); V1 interaction MS 0.452 vs preregistered noise 0.858, theta -0.406 [-0.704,-0.073].

Pair-level direct delta noise: 0.303 [0.200,0.427] disagreeing-only vs 0.858 cell-level; V1 cross-component theta +0.391 [-0.327,+0.368] unresolved. Interaction variance is not identifiable above the defensible noise envelope.

Meta-val structure-only census: 7,209 same-panel MMP observations / 2,757 potential D rows, but 0 exact keys shared with meta_train; repeated-key primary surface is unsuppliable on both development splits.
